messages:
nina_cs: spotted a surge of duplicate outbound nudges from the renewals playbook this morning. ~65 duplicates. digging in.

nina_cs: sample acct: ACCT-7209 - two identical 'renewal reminder' notes 7s apart.

ashok_ops: did any deploy touch playbook-runner in the last 12h?

miles_eng: no deploy. logs show repeated webhook delivery for the same event_id (crm_evt_9c3b). looks like the CRM retried after a 504. runner treated each delivery as new.

playbook-bot: autopilot: rule renewals-nudge-v3 fired 65 times for event crm_evt_9c3b within 10s. auto-dedupe=false in prod.

ashok_ops: temporary mitigation - suppress renewals-nudge-v3 for segment 'auto-renew' for 2h. `POST /ops/playbook/suppress` body `{"rule":"renewals-nudge-v3","segments":["auto-renew"],"ttl":"2h"}`

tara_enable: please export accounts with renewal < 180d and duplicates so enablement can triage.

nina_cs: exporting now: s3://cs-exports/renewal_dupes_1789012345.csv (65 rows). brief breakdown: 22 <180d, 6 <90d.

miles_eng: pushing a small idempotency change to runner: dedupe key = event_id + rule_name for 2m window. PR: github.com/redwood/inference/pull/8562

ashok_ops: suppression applied; returned 202. scheduling a cleanup job to collapse duplicate notes where body and timestamp within 15s. backfill audit tag: 'dedupe-1789012345'.

tara_enable: grabbing CSV and assigning the 6 <90d to renewal SDRs. also prepping a templated outreach for high-touch.

miles_eng: merged idempotency patch to staging, added integration test simulating rapid CRM retries. will roll to prod in next window. monitoring for any missed edge cases. :thumbsup:
